fields.description:
From: Dana Reyes (Support)

AcmeCo's security team re-tested after upgrading to 4.7.0 and the CSV export formula-injection issue still reproduces (their original report is in the support mailbox). The 4.7.0 release notes list RLY-2214 as fixed, and that is what we told them on Jun 12.

I saw there was a rollback during the 4.7.0 cycle - maybe the fix got caught in that; if so, please re-land it.

Their security team has blocked wider rollout on their side until they are on a release with this actually fixed, so what they need from us is a build they can install - not another assurance. Make this right for AcmeCo, and figure out how the release notes ended up saying something that is not true. I need to know what else in 4.7.0's notes we can't trust before I send the customer anything.
